'''Rod Latham Standard Hunt Down''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds113.htm Standard Hunt Down], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020727173448/http://trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds113.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
